note_verbatim: 完成五课一练习册星期一到星期四的练习题。

rule.zh: 录下朗读，边读边识别，再和课文逐字对照。没听到的字会标出来；百分比只在家长视图里，是识别结果，不是评分。
rule.en: Recorded as done with a time log, never scored. There is no honest way to mark fluency from a tap.

tasks.line: 完成五课一练习册星期一到星期四的练习题。
tasks.what: 练习册A 第五课，星期一到星期四

finding.zh: 设计原本以为按星期分四组；实际上每天只有一道选择题块，共十五题、两组。其余十七项现在都在网站上做：有唯一答案的按规则判；写字按笔顺判；自由书写（组词、造句、问答）用笔写，保存后由批改技能批改；讲故事录音、家长签名；读一读录音对照。纸上不再剩下作业。
finding.en: The design expected four sittings; the pages give one four-choice block a day. The other seventeen exercises are all done on the site now: one-answer ones marked by rule, known characters judged stroke by stroke, free writing (组词, 造句, answers) written with the pen and judged by the review skill, the retell recorded and signed, 读一读 read aloud and aligned. Nothing is left on paper.

known_gaps.where: 练习册A 星期一 练习4（2），printed p.32
known_gaps.question: 「正」共有＿＿画，部首是＿＿。
known_gaps.offered: A. 六；一   B. 五；正   C. 六；正   D. 五；一
known_gaps.why_omitted: Five strokes is certain; the radical is not. The PRC 《汉字部首表》 files 正 under 止, which the workbook does not offer, and textbooks split between 一 and 正. A wrong answer key is worse than a missing question. Ask her teacher, then add it. The parallel question about 突 is in zh-char and is safe: the textbook prints 穴 → 突 on p.50.

tasks.scope_note: The note says 词语 and names p.52. The section headed 词语 is on p.50; p.52 carries the last two rows of 读一读 and the whole of 用一用. The owner read the note literally — the words on p.52 — so both sections are listed here, labelled, and the parent may trim to the 读一读 rows if that is what the teacher dictates. The first draft of this file recorded the ten 生字 from p.50 instead; that matched neither the note's word nor its page and was withdrawn.

rule.zh: 先听，再在纸上写，然后显示对照，自己或家长打分。网站不批改手写。
rule.en: Shown, then self- or parent-rated, the way precision already works. Dictation means writing characters from hearing them; the site cannot mark that and must not pretend to.
